messages.content: What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?

function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. You might check a reliable weather website or app for the current temperature in Moscow.
message.reasoning: The user asks "What weather is now in Moscow, in Celsius?" They want current temperature. We need to provide answer. There's no tool for weather. So we can respond with approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can use external knowledge? As ChatGPT offline, we can't fetch live data. So we should respond that I cannot access real-time data. Or we could give a general typical range. But best practice: say I don't have real-time info.
